title: ～まで — “until / up to ～”
summary: A particle for the end point of time, place or an ongoing action. 〜から〜まで shows both the start and the end.

patterns.gloss: time or place + まで (五時まで)

body.p: 五時まで働きます means working continuously until five o’clock.
It shows the end of a journey or range, as in 駅まで行きます.
まで is how long an action continues. までに is a deadline by which it is done (六時までに帰ります).

examples.ja: 五時（ごじ）まで働（はたら）きます。
朝（あさ）から夜（よる）まで勉強（べんきょう）します。
examples.romaji: Asa kara yoru made benkyō shimasu.
examples.tr: I study from morning until night.

examples.ja: この電車（でんしゃ）は駅（えき）まで行（い）きます。
examples.romaji: Kono densha wa eki made ikimasu.
examples.tr: This train goes up to the station.

pitfalls: Do not mix up まで and までに. For deadlines use までに.
It is often paired with から.
